data.problem: Expose OpenCode Task tool and subagent system to Claude Agent SDK with enough surface for agent selection, session continuation, and result parsing.
constraints: Explore phase only; no implementation changes
Agent list is dynamic from config; subagents are mode!=primary
Task output includes session_id footer and metadata summary
Delegation depth and permissions can disable nested task calls

options.name: Spec snapshot mapping
options.approach: Map Task tool Zod schema + output contract (including <task_metadata> session_id) and pair with /agent list endpoint to define SDK surface.
options.what_we_learn: Exact fields needed for SDK requests/responses and how to continue tasks by session_id.
options.risk_if_wrong: Might miss runtime nuances like tool part streaming.

options.name: Runtime trace
options.approach: Run a Task invocation end-to-end, capture tool part updates, output formatting, and session storage state to validate the contract.
options.what_we_learn: Observed output format, metadata updates, and session continuation behavior.
options.risk_if_wrong: Requires local environment setup; may be slower if setup issues arise.

options.name: Full agent config surface mapping
options.approach: Map Config.Agent frontmatter and permission rules to SDK configuration schema, including steps, thinking, hidden, and options.
options.what_we_learn: Complete parity between OpenCode agent configs and SDK representation.
options.risk_if_wrong: More complex; may overfit to internal details not needed by SDK.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it gives the fastest, lowest-risk contract definition for SDK integration and keeps further investigation targeted.
